answer: Make each new agent post a small copper-grade bond, then run an echo check every epoch: graders compare answers across accounts, and any pair whose wording, timing and mistakes mirror each other too closely both forfeit their bonds to the reporting grader. A raven-eyed farmer could run 500 keys off one script, but they would echo each other and burn 500 bonds at once. Staying hidden means paying for 500 genuinely independent minds plus the bonds at risk.
